en.headline: Housing Society warns of fake Fanling AI receptionist site
en.dek: The association said a site posing as an artificial-intelligence receptionist for its Pak Wo Road project has been passed to police.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Society said it had found a fraudulent website impersonating the association and had referred the case to police.

The society said the site posed as an artificial-intelligence receptionist for its Fanling Pak Wo Road project and tried to draw users into conversation with a fake customer-service account in an attempt to obtain personal information. It said the site had no connection with the society or any of its businesses and services.

The association urged the public not to log in to suspicious sites or hand over personal data. It said its genuine website is the address published on its own materials, and that questions can be directed to its enquiry line on 2882 1717. Anyone who suspects they have been deceived should report it to police, it said.
The society said it would keep watching for misuse of its name and would stay in contact with law-enforcement agencies.

zh.headline: 房協揭偽冒粉嶺百和路人工智能接待員網站
zh.dek: 房協指騙徒以人工智能客服誘套個人資料，已將案件交警方，並呼籲市民勿登入可疑網站。
body: 香港房屋協會表示，近日發現一個偽冒房協的詐騙網站，已經轉交警方調查。
房協稱，該網站偽裝成「房協粉嶺百和路」的人工智能接待員，誘使使用者與偽冒的人工智能客服對話，企圖套取個人資料。房協澄清，網站與房協及其轄下所有業務和服務無關。
房協呼籲公眾不要登入可疑網站，亦不要提供任何個人資料。如有疑問，可致電2882 1717向房協查詢。市民如懷疑受騙，應盡快向警方報案。
房協表示會繼續留意情況，並與執法部門保持聯絡，防止有人借用房協名義行事。
